name: Sourdough starter, active (100% hydration)
source: Illustrative 1:1 (by mass) flour-and-water culture, close to wheat-flour-white.json's own dry-matter profile diluted by an equal mass of water, with a small carbohydrate share already consumed by fermentation.
notes: Built in origin/culture.ts by blending wheat-flour-white.json and water-liquid.json at equal mass shares (matching the flour file's own protein/fat/carbohydrate/ash pattern, scaled) and then reducing the carbohydrate share slightly to represent starch already metabolised by the wild yeast and lactic-acid bacteria culture — the same real fermentation-driven mass loss (as CO2, via respire()) that origin/culture.ts's propagateStarter() applies explicitly to a fresh batch, so an already-active starter's own resting composition reflects it too.
